text:
Priya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — final loop for Finley (SWE IC3) scheduled Tue 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET. We need: panel coverage, a scribe/transcript, and someone to own the debrief. Candidate requested transcript accessibility. Can folks volunteer? cc @Sam @Aisha
Sam: I can do the system design interview. Happy to be debrief owner if no one else volunteers.
Aisha: I can cover behavioral. For time allocation I’d do ~20m design / 25m coding / 15m behavioral. For rubric weights I’d lean: Design 40%, Coding 35%, Behavioral 25%. :+1:
Jordan: Heads up I’m OOO early afternoon that day — I can only do up to 10:30am PT. If the panel shifts to 11am PT I can join.
Elena: I can be backup scribe if needed. Also quick note: candidate indicated stronger Rust background — make coding prompt language-agnostic.
Alex (Recruiter): I’ll enable live captions on the Zoom and add the transcript permission in the calendar invite. Will also paste the scoring link in the invite. calendar-bot: event created: Finley — Final Loop — Tue 09:00 PT — Zoom link in invite.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks all. Can we lock scribe + debrief owner by EOD today? If Sam owns debrief, please submit within 24h after interview. Also small rubric snippet to include in the invite so everyone uses same weights:
```
Design: 40
Coding: 35
Behavioral: 25
Scribe: capture timestamps + short pros/cons bullets
Debrief owner: consolidate feedback, call rec (hire/hold/no-hire)
```
Sam: Will take debrief ownership. I’ll scribe unless Elena prefers to.
Elena: I’ll scribe the session — happy to take raw notes so Sam can synthesize. :raised_hands:
Aisha: Quick clarification — for behavioral questions that reference past orgs, do we penalize for lacking exact scale (startup vs enterprise)? My assumption: focus on leadership signals, not org size.
Priya (People Ops): Correct — evaluate on signal, not prior company size. Add a line in the invite: "When scoring behavioral, prioritize decision making and impact signals over company size/scale."
Jordan: One more logistics ask — can the coding interviewer post the prompt in the thread 30m before start so the panel can scan?
Sam: Will do — I’ll drop the prompt + test cases at 8:30am PT on Tue.
Alex (Recruiter): All set on my end — I’ll confirm candidate availability for transcript start, and ping again if anything changes.
Priya (People Ops): Great. If anyone needs to swap, please call it out here asap so we can find coverage. Thanks!
